speech:
Alright, Grizzly Rips, gather round. Wednesday gets a B-, and I think that's fair. Not a parade, but a mighty fine day of honest work.

We went 1 win, 2 draws and 1 loss across 4 matches. We scored 15 and let in 10. Our average rating was 8.7, way up over our usual 7.86, and we outrated the other side all day. We started the day in Division 2 with 0 of 16 points and 2 of 3 chances left. We finished it in Division 2 with 5 of 16 points and 1 chance left. That means we need 11 more for promotion to Division 1. It's a steep hill, but y'all have climbed steeper.

The headline is that 8-2 over begeshana LLC. That wasn't a win, that was a barn raising. Everybody grabbed a hammer and the whole thing went up before lunch.

PhogsToffees, you hung a perfect 10.0 on that one. That's your 10th perfect rating for this club, and you took 10 shots, way up from your usual 3. You played that match like you'd paid for the whole buffet and meant to eat it. Over the day you had 6 goals, 5 assists and 7 key passes, and your 8.65 average beat your usual 8.29. Now the notes. You fired 21 shots and only 9 hit the target. Against Goners12345 your conversion was 0%. Then against Kalulu FC you gave the ball away 18 times, nearly double your usual 10, and missed 6 tackles. That's the one we lost 2-3, and you know it.

BellyTb1, you were the steadiest engine in the barn. You had 6 goals, 3 assists and an 8.75 average against your usual 8.28. You posted 9.8 twice, and against Goners12345 you were on the ball 49 times when you usually manage 34. I loved the hustle in the big win, too, with 9 tackles attempted when you usually try 3. But 9 of those tackles missed. You won only 4 of 17 all day, and your shot accuracy in that match dropped to 20%. You also misplaced 12 passes against Goners12345 when you usually misplace 7.

So here's our coaching point, and it's about shot selection. Work the ball into the middle of the box before you pull the trigger. If you're on a tight angle, cut it back to your teammate, because a better shot beats a first shot. If you've got half a second, set your feet. Off-balance shots end up in the cheap seats. And we let in 2.5 a match, so a little more bite in the tackle wouldn't hurt.

But listen. Two forwards put up 12 goals, 8 assists and a perfect 10 in one afternoon. That's no accident. That's chemistry, the kind you can't buy at any store in Kansas or anywhere else.

Five points are in the bag and 11 are left to find. I believe y'all are going to find every last one. Get some rest, Grizzly Rips. Tomorrow we go get 'em.
